description.zh:
订阅实例ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the instance ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

description.zh:
订阅任务ID，可以调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
> 参数**DtsInstanceId**与**DtsJobId**，两者必须传入其一。
description.en:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.
> You must specify one of the **DtsInstanceId** and **DtsJobId** parameters.

description.zh: 页码，取值为大于**0**且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.
The number of records per page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.
The parent task ChannelId of the distributed task.

description.zh: DTS订阅实例所在地域的ID，请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the DTS change tracking instance. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

title.zh: 查询订阅任务的消费组详情
title.en: Query consumer group details of a change tracking task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-consumer-channel --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id dtsboss6pn1w000000 --dts-job-id boss6pn1w000000 --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --parent-channel-id dtsan5114c52000000 --resource-group-id rg-aek3dcgyq7pnqwa --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeConsumerChannel --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId boss6pn1w000000 --PageSize 20 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek3dcgyq7pnqwa' --PageNumber 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ParentChannelId dtsan5114c52000000 --DtsInstanceId dtsboss6pn1w000000
